But why else would the lights flicker like that?  

I used to enjoy things—weekend barbecues, fixing up the truck—but now I just stay in. I don’t know if it’s the mood bringing on the thoughts, or the thoughts making me feel worse. Honestly, I can’t tell when one starts and the other stops. The only thing I’m sure of is that something’s not right.

That’s exactly what they’d want her to think.

I still go to work every day, do a solid job welding—my boss hasn’t said a thing about performance. But those thoughts about being watched and sabotaged?
